title: Constructibility descends through a finite surjection
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism between schemes of finite type over $k$,
and let $\pi:Y\to X$ be finite and surjective, in the sense of
[def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. If $\mathcal C(f\pi)$ holds,
then $\mathcal C(f)$ holds, with $\mathcal C$ as in
[def-finrepair-property-c].

proof.text: Convert C(pi f) from finite-constant-value constructibility to finite-stalk constructibility using [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison]. For q >= 0, [src-right-derived-functor-plus-compatibility] identifies higherDirectImage with homology of the unbounded derived direct image. For q < 0, this homology is zero because the right derived functor of lowerStar applied to a sheaf in degree zero is concentrated in degrees >= 0 (Functor.isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj_singleFunctor). Thus obtain HasConstructibleDirectImages Lambda (pi >> f).

For each constructible Q, let G = pi^* Q. The theorem [prop-constructible-pullback] gives constructibility of G. Apply [lem-fin-finite-morphism] to pi with coefficient hypothesis hX, and convert by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison], to get constructibility of pi_*G. The unit Q -> pi_*G is monic by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-surjective-unit-mono], realized on module sheaves by the proved source theorem mono_unit_app_of_surjective (which needs only surjectivity).

Finite direct image is exact by [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact]. Form the explicit three-factor isomorphism: apply Rf_* to the inverse of the single-sheaf compatibility for exact pi_*, then to the inverse of rightDerivedFunctorLowerStarIsoMapDerivedCategory, and finally compose with rightDerivedLowerStarComp. This identifies Rf_*((pi_*G)[0]) with R(pi f)_*(G[0]). These are the existing exact-derived and canonical derived compositor interfaces; their composition is written in the Lean proof, rather than deduced from a spectral sequence. The hypothesis from step 1 gives constructible homology on the right, and invariance under isomorphism transfers it to the left.

Apply [lem-finrepair-constructible-direct-images-from-embeddings] to the embeddings of step 2 and the good direct images of step 3. This is the already-proved finite-order version of the blueprint resolution argument; it yields HasConstructibleDirectImages Lambda f without a full Cartan--Eilenberg spectral sequence or any uniform vanishing bound.

For each natural q and constructible F on X, use [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] on F, evaluate the conclusion of step 4, transport backwards across [src-right-derived-functor-plus-compatibility], and convert constructibility back. The result is precisely HasConstructibleHigherDirectImages with every original hypothesis retained.

proof_origin.place: Reuse the proved hasConstructibleDirectImages_of_exists_mono resolution principle; supply the finite-cover unit, finite constructible pushforward, and explicit exact-derived composition isomorphism.
